 Recusal
 In the exercise of my official duties as Director of Appointments in the Office of the Prime Minister, I recused myself on February 26, 2025 from a discussion or decision regarding the appointment of my friend Patricia Beh to the Parole Board of Canada in order to avoid any conflict of interest between my official functions and the private interest of my friend. 
 On February 6, 2024, in the exercise of my official duties as Director of Appointments in the Office of the Prime Minister, I recused myself from discussions and decision concerning the appointment of a friend, George Dolhai, as Director of Public Prosecutions in order to avoid any appearance of preferential treatment or any opportunity to improperly further the private interest of a friend.
